pair_e2c2af.evidence: Twenty weight-only investigations identify coherent projection changes, nonlinear-core coefficient differences, normalization-sensitive writing routes, and specific altered writer-to-reader connections. Full-reader checks confirm geometric retargeting but also show that large enrichment ratios do not imply comparably large coefficient changes. No test identifies agreement versus correctness or establishes activation-dependent causal importance. Components are inspection priorities. A is an arbitrary forced tie-break.
